title: Demo tutorial on an Android phone: the guide's box now lands on the right button
sub: A visitor walked all 8 steps on the big demo company on Google's Android phone emulator (Pixel 7 size, Chrome 124). Every press was a real finger tap in the middle of the guide's box. Live now: b9a6c3a5. The big company itself is NOT switched on - see the question.

sections.h: Fixed: the box pointed off the screen or at the wrong thing

pair.cap: Before · step 4 "choose the shop": the box was off the left edge, the screen only went dark
Now · the box sits on the phone's own customer bar
Now · a button inside the order: first "open the order" on Bayar
then the photo key. Before: off the left edge, like the shop
Before · after the sale the box sat on the receipt's title (the button it meant was under the receipt)
Now · "close the receipt first" on CLOSE RECEIPT

items.cap: Now · the open order covers the shelf: "close the order first". Before: the box's middle sat on Free sample
Now · the EOD send key is scrolled back on the screen. Before: 5 px of it showed
Now · stock count: "fill this box too". Before: it said Submit after one box and the app refused

sections.h: The 8 steps on the phone, big company

items.cap: 1 · Owner: goods in from the factory
2 · Owner: send goods to the area warehouse
5 · Dika: take back a damaged pack
8 · Owner: count the Master Vault - Submit

sections.note: Step 8: a count that is different from the stock has to be typed twice ("Count this one again"). The app says so on the row, but the guide does not explain it yet, so a visitor who types any number gets stuck there.

items.cap: the refusal a visitor sees after Submit
